OWNER (open): WHETHER A PARK SHOULD GIVE THE THREAD A NOTICE. Not decided and not designed. Facts for the decision: an executor park (typed stop) appends nothing today (the committed failure path appended an explanation, a park does not); a crash park has no executor stream and no gateway involvement, so a notice would have to be appended by session-core's worker through the same append path (and must not count as a message after the fold, which is irrelevant here because crash-park reads no messages); a notice must be fixed, content-free text and must not reach a ZDR or waived run (they never park); ordering relative to the eventual answer and a duplicate notice on a second park are product questions.

OWNER (open): THE CRASH TTL. Default 3600 s with a clamp of 60 s to 30 days is a proposal. It is the longest a crash park nothing resumes can delay outcome_unknown BEYOND the 15-minute deadline, which the re-seal itself waits for: the total is 15 minutes plus the TTL (75 minutes by default; no value gives the committed 15). Alternatives: the park TTL (24 h, simpler, costs a day), or a few minutes if a resumer will act at once. RETENTION is part of this decision: before S8-B a crashed run's sealed fold was purged about 15 minutes after the last heartbeat; with (6) on it lives to the deadline plus the crash TTL (clamp up to 30 days), so the TTL is also how long a crashed run's conversation ciphertext is kept. Not a ZDR matter (ZDR and waived runs never get one), but the owner's call.

OWNER (open): EXTEND TO EFFECT-CAPABLE RUNS? v1 refuses them because a crash makes their effects unknowable and the fold fence covers only root effects (a child can run a Write-class call with no fold save). Extending needs: the v4 ledger-after-fold fact (reserved_at against the fold's updated_at, both database now(), with a skew margin that makes it conservative) plus a fence that stops a zombie's later reservations (a loop identity on ReserveToolAction, or a store check against a crash-parked fold), plus a policy on a possibly-effected call. Recommended only after a resumer exists.

OWNER (open): EXTEND TO RUNS THAT SEND CLIENT TOOLS? The gateway's park form sends no tools, so a resume cannot offer them; marking such runs would hold them for the TTL. Needs either the client tools stored in the fold (a content decision) or the resume re-supplied with them (a gateway contract change). Note the SPA's subscription Do turn sends none, so this concerns other callers.

OWNER (open): THE EXACT BELT (R3), optional. Round 4 closed the healthy-loop transient case by failing closed, so the duplicate-answer paths left are the configuration-skew ones (R19b: a writer that is Off or Failed for a non-ownership reason cannot tombstone) and anything unforeseen that delivers a late append. The exact belt would be an idempotent final answer per run (a unique partial index on the final assistant message per thread and run with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING in append_message_in_tx; a migration) or the v4 thread watermark (migration 0049 plus a claim that takes the thread lock). Neither is built. The owner decides whether the drain-before-rolling rule suffices, and whether the cost of failing closed (a degraded session-core at run end costs the run its answer) is acceptable against it.

OWNER (open): ACCEPT THE VISIBLE EFFECTS OF FLIP (5) (R4): no late answer or receipt from a marked loop whose run was cancelled or ended under it, none from a live loop silent past the deadline when bearers are long-lived, recovery instead of an immediate failed receipt only for a marked loop that overran its credentials AND whose own last heartbeat is 780 s old or older (a recent one keeps the committed failed receipt), a stop at the next loop top for a healthy armed loop with a stored marked fold and a round longer than 780 s, a retryable agent_dispatch_unavailable frame on a user's Stop, and no answer from a marked loop whose tombstone cannot be confirmed (a degraded session-core at run end: R3, F23)?

OWNER/LEAD (open): THE COVERAGE COST OF THE VISIBLE-CALL FENCE (R13). A crash inside a plan-proposing or delegation round is not parkable (after a successful fence). The alternative is to drop the fence and accept a second plan proposal or a second delegation record after a resume.

OWNER/LEAD (open): THE AUTOMATIC RESUMER, if the owner chooses one as the prerequisite: it needs backoff and a per-run crash budget below the park cap (R19c) or a poison run can kill an executor five times and every in-flight run with it. It also needs a rule for how a client retry and a resume interact: the stopped loop's stream ends in a RETRYABLE agent_dispatch_unavailable frame, so a client retry starts a NEW run while the stopped one is crash-parkable, and with a resumer the turn could be answered twice.
